"""Cache-budgeted IPv6 image compiler: exact globally optimal packed images."""
import json
import sys
from bisect import bisect_right

import fib
import image
import planner
from protocol import Invalid, MAX_INPUT, parse_request

BIGV = 1 << 62
MAX_RUNS = 64
MAX_TOTAL_RUNS = 128


def build_versions(case):
    """Apply the ordered transactions, keeping every immutable FIB version."""
    routes = {}
    for route, hop in case["initial"]:
        routes[route] = hop
    versions = [fib.compile_runs(routes)]
    for transaction in case["transactions"]:
        for op, route, hop in transaction:
            if op == "set":
                routes[route] = hop
            else:
                routes.pop(route, None)
        versions.append(fib.compile_runs(routes))
    return versions
